name: Limit Status 1 Code
definition: Specifies the current status of a limit.

DISA.name: Disabled
DISA.definition: Limit is not currently in effect.

DELD.name: Deleted
DELD.definition: Limit has been deleted or suspended.

REQD.name: Requested
REQD.definition: Limit has been asked for and is not yet enabled.
